title: PredictiveAlert
description: Forecast-driven alert emitted by forecasting-service and served by `GET /alerts` and `GET /alerts/{alert_id}` (docs/CONTRACTS.md §3). Emitted for any predicted p90 breach in the horizon; lead_time_minutes below ALERT_MIN_LEAD_MINUTES (default 10) marks a late warning against the REQ-E target. Severity derives from the peak p90 overshoot of the threshold: <10% low, <25% medium, <50% high, >=50% critical. At most one alert with status `open` exists per (component_id, metric_name).

metric_name.description: Logical metric name as configured in config/components.yaml, e.g. `cpu`, `memory`, `error_rate`.

predicted_breach_time.description: UTC time at which the p90 forecast first crosses the threshold.

predicted_value.description: Peak forecast (p90) value within the horizon; drives severity.

threshold.description: Threshold in force when the alert was created.

playbook_id.description: Set once diagnostic-service returns a playbook; null until then (or if the hand-off failed).

componentId.description: Monitored component id. Known ids: ingestion-service, forecasting-service, diagnostic-service, kafka, zookeeper, prometheus, graph-db, llm. Kept open (not an enum) so new components can be added via config/components.yaml without a schema change.

utcDateTime.description: UTC ISO-8601 date-time; `Z` or `+00:00` suffix (Python datetime.isoformat() emits `+00:00`).
